title: Croatian Fruit Wrap
description: A sweet and refreshing dessert wrap filled with dried fruit and kissed with love. Perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: Roll out the dough wrap to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Spread the fruit jam evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border.
Sprinkle the dried fruit mix over the jam.
Fold the bottom edge of the dough up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
Place the wrap seam-side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the dough is golden brown.
Dust with powdered sugar and sprinkle with cinnamon, if desired.
